title: Aranyak (Of the Forest)
author: Bibhutibhushan Bandyopadhyay
notes: A meditative masterpiece exploring the ancient primordial forests of Bihar, the dispossession of forest communities, and the melancholic friction between modern civilization and untouched wilderness.
memorablePassages: In the silence of the night, under the immense starlit sky of the forest, the vanity of human ambition dissolves.
